people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.
translations.bsb: He inquired of the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.
translations.kjv: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
translations.asv: And when Saul inquired of Jehovah, Jehovah answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
